summary: Added a tax-expenditure / subsidy-hygiene discipline so the archive does not let hidden spending through housing and retirement preferences quietly rebuild incumbent wealth or capitalise into prices while the visible program claims to broaden ownership.

working_target.bottom_half_asset_floor: positive net wealth, liquid shock buffer, secure housing position, durable long-run asset claim, non-predatory debt position
working_target.intergenerational_circulation: adult asset position not strongly inherited through parental wealth, education, or homeownership
working_target.life_course_timing: first durable footholds should arrive early enough to shape adulthood rather than mainly through late inheritance
working_target.reconcentration_pressure: broad gains should survive normal rent, markup, asset-price, and tax-arbitrage cycles
working_target.social_floor_condition: private wealth targets must be read alongside healthcare, pensions, housing security, and other public/social protections
working_target.legibility_precondition: major ownership and transfer channels must be visible enough to measure, tax, and police
working_target.encumbrance_condition: broad household wealth should be resilient enough that ownership is not mostly thin equity resting on heavy debt-service exposure or dangerous leverage
working_target.stewardship_condition: broader capital claims should not be counted as full democratic ownership if voting power and engagement remain concentrated in a narrow intermediary layer
working_target.person_level_condition: household-level broadening should not count as success if many adults still lack direct title, direct liquid control, direct pension rights, or fair exit security
working_target.group_stratification_condition: historically subordinated groups should not remain structurally excluded from durable ownership, secure tenure, safe credit, entrepreneurship, inheritances, or other main asset-building channels even if national averages improve
working_target.budgeting_condition: major wealth-relevant packages should be tested early, publicly, and revisably across wealth formation, floor security, timing, person-level ownership, and group access rather than income alone
working_target.non_extractive_formation_condition: broad wealth gains should come mainly through better earnings, saving, productive investment, social inheritance, and open access rather than scarcity rents, monopoly markups, fee extraction, or incumbent revaluation that worsens entry
working_target.downside_discipline_condition: concentrated owners or major intermediaries should not be able to repeatedly privatise upside while major downside is shifted onto taxpayers or public balance sheets; unavoidable public support should be last-resort, targeted, conditional, and recoverable
working_target.public_value_capture_condition: windfalls created by infrastructure, rezoning, development permissions, or strategic public-land decisions should flow partly back into public/social wealth, affordable access, or common infrastructure rather than capitalising almost entirely into private fortunes

revision_focus: add a compact program note on tax expenditures, upside-down subsidies, and subsidy redesign
extend the scoreboard with incidence, capitalization, and instrument-design checks for hidden wealth-state support
tighten budgeting, tax, housing, and sequencing surfaces around cleaning the hidden wealth state early rather than after reform has already been diluted
keep the archive waist narrow with two narrow source anchors and surgical edits rather than a new main axis
